title.narrative: Support for Oman's Environment Authority with a Mobile Veterinary Clinic for Arabian Leopard Care

description.narrative: Improve veterinary health services for Arabian leopards through veterinarians, and strengthen cross-country cooperation through the Arabian Leopard Fund to reduce the risk of extinction and preserve wildlife.
Strengthening the veterinary healthcare system for the Arabian leopard and enabling timely medical intervention to protect it from extinction and reduce mortality.
Support for the efforts of Oman's Environment Authority.
Disbursement for "Support for Oman's Environment Authority with a Mobile Veterinary Clinic for Arabian Leopard Care" in Oman, implemented by Arabian Leopard Fund
